title: Judgments only cite
goal: A judgment never shows as amending, repealing or replacing a law: its links to laws are cites only (user, 2026-11-17, before inviting a junior who argues from case law).
for_whom: A practising lawyer reading a section's history (as amended, changed by) or a judgment's Cited by in the app.

done_check.check: After the relink and publish, kb.links has 0 links from a ca:/sc: document whose kind is not cites (60 on 2026-11-17: amends 44, repeals 3, replaces 1, amends_act 2, repeals_act 4, rescinds 6); each of those 60 is kept as a cites link; no other source's links change; test_v2 and gold-links 210/210 pass.

scenarios.steps: In the app, open section 10 of Act No. 23 of 2011 (which the Court of Appeal tax judgment ca:ca-tax-46-2019 was wrongly linked as amending) and read its history; then open that judgment.
scenarios.expect: The section's changes list only Acts; the judgment still appears as citing that section (Cited by).

out_of_scope: Judgments that really change a law's effect (a section struck down): not modelled.
Re-embedding: links only, no text or vector change.

decisions.note: The fix is in the ETL (links from a judgment are cites), not a filter in the app, so every reader of kb.links gets it.
Cost: relink of the 4,433 judgments and a links-only publish (production write, asks); no rebuild of other documents, no embed.

progress.note: Fix 8a45a3d (run.cite_only, a judgment's links fingerprint carries |cite_only; test in test_v2).
